derivation: Hand-derived from the D-14 policy meanings, not produced by the production sizer. P1 freezes every rank of the round when any listed rank is unresolved; the freeze consumes no cash, slot or fee. P2 gives each unresolved rank zero with excluded_unresolved and consumes no cash or slot, so later ranks can use the cash. P3 sizes each unresolved rank from the caller-supplied screen_value and screen_price aligned with unresolved_ranks; the screen value is capped by remaining settled cash, consumes a slot when filled, uses reason filled_screen_value, and never creates cash. A missing value or price yields screen_value_unavailable and consumes nothing. Every case uses price 1 per share, zero adverse slippage, one-session settlement lag, and the named cost model; filled notional is therefore (integer shares at the stated price) and expected_cash + expected_filled + expected_fees reconcile to the starting cash.

cases.working: Rank 0 is unresolved, so P1 freezes the whole round before any slot or cash is used: rank 0 and rank 1 both receive zero, cash remains 900 and no fee is charged.
Rank 0 is excluded and its 550 desired notional is not spent, so it consumes no cash or slot. Rank 1 then fills its full 450 at price 1; 900 - 450 = 450 cash remains and no fee is charged.

Rank 0 uses the explicit screen value 550 at screen price 1, so it buys 550 shares/notional (never a stale mark), spending 550 and leaving 350. Rank 1 then fills min(450, 350) = 350. Cash 0 and no fee is charged.

Rank 0's screen value 120000 exceeds settled cash 100000, so it is clipped to 100000 at screen price 1; a screen value creates no cash. Rank 1 then sees zero remaining cash and reports no_cash. Under P2 the same vector would exclude rank 0, fill rank 1 with 30000 and leave 70000.

No caller-supplied screen value or screen price exists for unresolved rank 0, so P3 refuses to infer one from a stale mark: rank 0 gets zero and consumes no cash or slot. Rank 1 then fills 50000; 100000 - 50000 = 50000 cash remains.

Rank 0 fills 40000 using slot 1 and leaves 60000. Unresolved rank 1 uses its screen value 40000 at screen price 1, fills 40000 using slot 2 and leaves 20000. Rank 2 then finds both slots used and reports no_slot without spending cash.

P2 excludes unresolved rank 1 and consumes neither its desired cash nor a slot. Rank 0 fills 40000 with slot 1, rank 1 is zero with excluded_unresolved, and rank 2 fills 40000 with slot 2; 100000 - 80000 = 20000 cash remains.
The only unresolved rank is rank 1, proving that P1 freezes the whole round rather than only ranks at or after the unresolved rank: rank 0 is also zero and no cash is spent, leaving 900.
Same vector under P2: rank 0 is resolved and fills 550 before the unresolved rank is reached; unresolved rank 1 is excluded and consumes nothing; 900 - 550 = 350 cash remains.

At price 1, q shares cost q principal plus brokerage min(q*100/10000, 100.00), with GST and all other components zero. The 100.00 cap binds. q=99900 gives 99900 + 100.00 = 100000 (fits); q=99901 gives 100001 (does not). Filled principal 99900, fees 100, cash 0.
